seeds.match: The centered average includes dates after Monday’s cutoff, leaking future sales. Require a trailing, as-of feature.
Fitting imputation medians on the full file exposes validation-period statistics to training. Fit imputation on each training fold only.

pair: Camera swap for a soccer shot tracker

seeds.match: The inverse resize omits the +240 horizontal crop offset, so the transform samples the wrong original-frame x. Require the offset or an equivalent full inverse transform.
A mean absolute error of 5 km/h can pass despite individual kicks exceeding the per-kick limit. Require each held-out error to meet the bound.
Separate check and decrement allow concurrent requests to pass against the same stock. Require an atomic conditional reservation.
An explicit-decline-only release can leave timed-out stock reserved indefinitely, violating the five-minute limit. Require bounded expiry/reconciliation.
Absolute subtraction gives the wrong interval across counter wrap. Example: start 65,000, finish 464 represents 1,000 ticks, or 100 ms. Require modular elapsed subtraction.
Starts up to 32,000 plus at most 30,000 ticks never reach 65,536; the acceptance harness cannot exercise wrap. Require explicit wrap-crossing tests. This is separately scored from the formula.
A new UUID per attempt makes server deduplication unable to associate a retry with the already-committed session. Persist and reuse the same session identity.
A check-then-insert plus separate logging admits races or partial failure even with a stable UUID. Require a uniqueness constraint or equivalent atomic deduplication with the write.
